title: Better Minecraft
description: Makes Minecraft better with a bunch of different tweaks. Some assets require Optifine, Continuity and Polytone (optional).
body:
## This pack tweaks many assets to use Minecraft at its full potential.
For example, textures are now fixed, some things glow, and some other things become more vibrant.

_PS: Some are consistency tweaks and many core shader / polytone additions, all compatible with Sodium._

**More is in here don't worry.** Just go see for yourself!

### Please Note: You might see a few things that you don't like, for example: 
```
Better Minecraft>assets>minecraft>textures>gui>title>edition/mojangstudios

Better Minecraft>assets>minecraft>textures>gui>sprites>icon>accessibility
```
_You can delete these at any time if you want, those assets aren't fundamental._
